therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: BRAF kinase inhibition and MEK kinase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: MAPK pathway inhibition in melanoma cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Drug concentrations in plasma, brain metastases, and CSF

results.target_engagement_evidence: Dabrafenib and metabolites detected in brain metastases tissue (0-261 ng/mL range) and CSF (0-36.9 ng/mL range), demonstrating CNS penetration
results.dose_information: Dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily orally under fasting conditions; Trametinib 2.0 mg once daily orally under fasting conditions

context.investigator_commentary: Study was terminated due to low enrollment
